# Phase A synthetic fixtures

All protein residues and mappings here are synthetic mechanics fixtures, not
IPD biological sequences or evidence of real HLA protein equivalence. Allele
names exercise the frozen HLA syntax only. No download, live lookup, completion,
peptide generation, presentation prediction or self-query search occurs.

`e2e.json` declares donor and recipient roles and a pinned local reference.
A*02:01 resolves exactly; B*07:02 retains two distinct sequence hypotheses.
A*24:02 exercises equivalent pinned higher-field sequences without imputing a
genotype. C*03:04 lacks residues; C*04:01 is explicitly unsupported. N/L
annotations remain independent of sequence availability and antigen absence.
